|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date; the image may be older). It prints word for word the text of [[Hopping Mad (V)]] (the original). It is listed as its own version (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The current text is [[Hopping Mad (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[Hopping Mad (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on non-[Episode I] C-3PO. Once per turn, you may ▲ How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Mantellian Savrip, Thank The Maker, or We're Doomed. If C-3PO present at a battleground, Savrip is [Immune to Alter]. Thank The Maker is a Used Interrupt and treat "5" in its game text as "3".”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 125. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-125-Hopping_Mad.png]]) prints slip number “125” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Hopping Mad (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) put the four cards in a different order (How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Thank The Maker, We're Doomed, Mantellian Savrip) and set 5 and 3 in single quotation marks; it writes the ▲ and Immune to Alter icons out as words (“take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, “immune to Alter”): “Deploy on non-[Episode I] C-3PO. Once per turn, you may take How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Thank The Maker, We're Doomed, or Mantellian Savrip into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If C-3PO present at a battleground, Savrip is immune to Alter. Thank The Maker is a Used Interrupt and treat '5' in its game text as '3'.”.<ref name="cl-1220_125-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-hoppingmad-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual2-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/hoppingmad.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034559/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual2-Light], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock2-Light/large/hoppingmad.gif</ref>: “Deploy on non-[Episode I] C-3PO. Once per turn, you may ▲ How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Mantellian Savrip, Thank The Maker, or We're Doomed. If C-3PO present at a battleground, Savrip is [Immune to Alter]. Thank The Maker is a Used Interrupt and treat "5" in its game text as "3".” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 2 set mark) and prints the number “125” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Hopping Mad (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 24), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=24, page 24. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=24 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on non-[Episode I] C-3PO. Once per turn, you may ▲ How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Mantellian Savrip, Thank The Maker, or We're Doomed. If C-3PO present at a battleground, Savrip is [Immune to Alter]. Thank The Maker is a Used Interrupt and treat "5" in its game text as "3".” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1220-125-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
